context:
Goal: your Mac coordinator starts its lane sessions with no click from you.
Problem (goal): the desktop app shows a card for each start unless it is kind user_asked on a turn you typed; no setting or hook removes it.
Based on (measured): your probe, 13:55 CST Nov 6 (item 296): user_asked on your typed turn, no card, 2 of 2; offer, card.
Based on (read): "Allow rules have no effect in bypassPermissions" (code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes.md); the card showed in Bypass on Oct 26.
Departs from: main, decision lanes-start-as-agents "each Mac lane start is one press" — becomes one typed line per batch.
Meanwhile: the lane waits for your pick, then builds it. Probe 2 (item 296) checks the branch cut and does not block this pick.
holds: How the Mac coordinator starts lane sessions.
lane: lane local-lane-start-no-click (session_013NEJL2TLonvddw6ByF5XGE): use user_asked for every start; test it on a turn you did not type; routed 14:03 CST

lastAnswer.note: how can these be your answers after A and B started with no work, but C needed a button? What was the reason?

options.gain: One line from you per batch, no card.
options.how: You type "start the lanes"; on that turn the coordinator starts every ready lane with kind user_asked.
options.label: One typed line per batch
options.lose: A lane that becomes ready later waits for your next line.

options.gain: No line and no card, ever.
options.how: Mac lanes run as background agents in the coordinator, not sessions.
options.label: Lanes as background agents
options.lose: Goes against your ruling of 2026-11-04 (item 168, a lane is a session); a lane dies with the coordinator.

options.label: Keep one press per start
options.lose: One card per lane, as today.

reply: You are right: the options missed the plain fix. C showed a card because it used kind 'offer', which by design is a suggestion card you accept. A and B used kind 'user_asked', which starts at once, so the fix is to always use user_asked. The one open point: your probe ran on a turn you typed, so whether user_asked also starts with no card on a turn a message woke is unmeasured. Sent to the c107 lane at 14:03 CST to use user_asked for every start and test the woken-turn case. No question for you unless that test shows a card.
title: How should your Mac coordinator start lanes with no click?
why: Your ask (13:24 CST): local coordinators still need your press to start each lane.
